lines.text: خوف وکسوف را که جمیع احوالات آن تحت الارض باشد در تقویم ننویسند چه جمهور اهل احکام
lines.en: They do not write the fear and eclipse, all of whose conditions are under the earth, in the calendar, because the majority of the people of judgments

lines.text: برآنند که انرا اثري نیست و احکام طالع تحویل سال از احوال اصناف الناس و چگونگی
lines.en: are of the opinion that it has no effect. And the judgments of the ascendant of the turning of the year concerning the conditions of the classes of people, and the manner of

lines.text: حصول ارتفاع و باقي احوال از قحط و خصب و امن و اشوب و صحت و مرض و کیفیت
lines.en: the occurrence of elevation and the rest of the conditions from famine and plenty and security and turmoil and health and disease and the quality of

lines.text: احوال ولایت علی سبیل الاجمال در ورق مقدم بر اوراق دوازده گانه نویسند و اگر
lines.en: the conditions of the province in a summary manner in the page preceding the twelve pages they write. And if

lines.text: قران علوینی در سالی بوقوع آید و احکام انرا علیحده در ذیل احکام طالع تحویل سال
lines.en: a conjunction of the two superior planets occurs in a year, and its judgments separately under the judgments of the ascendant of the turning of the year

lines.text: ایراد کنند و همچنین احکام اجتماع و استقبال و اتصالات کلی در هر ماهی بر سر ورق
lines.en: they adduce. And likewise the judgments of the conjunction and opposition and the universal applications in every month at the head of the leaf

lines.text: انماه مخلوط بیکدیگر نویسند و در بعضی تقاویم نامه احکام اتصالات کلی را در سر صفحه یمنی
lines.en: of that month they write mixed with one another. And in some almanacs, the letter of the judgments of the universal applications at the head of the right page

lines.text: و احکام اجتماع و استقبال را در سر صفحه یسری نویسند و در بعضی دیگر تاریخ ولادت و رحلت
lines.en: and the judgments of the conjunction and opposition at the head of the left page they write. And in some others, the date of the birth and passing

lines.text: انبیا و ائمه و اولیا و علما و سلاطین ماضیه نویسند و همچنین تاریخ جلوس ایشان در هر سالی آن
lines.en: of the prophets and imams and saints and scholars and past sultans they write, and likewise the date of their accession in every year, that

lines.text: با یکدیگر بعد از احکام طالع تحویل نویسند و بعضی از منجمان منوبات کواکب سبعه سیاره
lines.en: with one another after the judgments of the ascendant of the turning they write. And some of the astrologers, the periods of the seven wandering planets

lines.text: و خطوط ایشان در بروج اثنی عشری و احکام انقلابات اعضا و احکام قوس و قزح و از
lines.en: and their lines in the twelve signs, and the judgments of the solstices of the members, and the judgments of the rainbow, and of

lines.text: باب ساعات و انچه بدین مانند مثل احکام غالب و مغلوب و معرفت رجال الغیب و سیر
lines.en: the chapter of hours and what is like this, such as the judgments of the victor and the vanquished and the knowledge of the men of the unseen and the movement of

lines.text: المحبه و احکام زلازل و اعود و ذود و دابه و معرفه سکر بلید و رو احکام زجر الفال
lines.en: of love, and the judgments of earthquakes, and the return and the driving away and the beast, and the knowledge of the drunkenness of the stupid, and the judgments of the augury of the omen

lines.text: داد و قوع و شرائط ادنیه الادله و احکام چگونگی وقوع ابله در بروج در اوراق
lines.en: gave and the occurrence and the conditions of the lowest of the proofs, and the judgments of the manner of the occurrence of the fool in the signs in the leaves

lines.text: مقدم بر اوراق دوازده گانه و مؤخر از اوراق احکام طالع تحویل بیارند و چونکه
lines.en: preceding the twelve pages and following the pages of the judgments of the ascendant of the turning they bring. And since

lines.text: انها محتاج به بیان نیست و انچه محتاج باشد در برهان صفحه شرح آن داده شده در اکثری
lines.en: they do not need explanation, and what is needed in the proof of the page its explanation has been given in most

lines.text: از تقاویم اختیارات ایام فرس و منازل قمر و نظرات او با سایر کواکب سیاره و
lines.en: of the calendars the choices of the days of the Persians and the mansions of the moon and its aspects with the other wandering planets and

lines.text: حالات او و همچنین بودن قمر در بروج اثنی عشریه در اوراق مقدم بر اوراق
lines.en: its conditions and also the being of the moon in the twelve signs in the pages preceding the pages

lines.text: دوازده گانه و موخر از اوراق مذکوره بنویسند اینست معرفت انچه متداولست
lines.en: of the twelve and following the mentioned pages they write. This is the knowledge of what is customary

summary.headline: Almanac Contents and Astrological Judgments
summary.text: Discussion of almanac contents and arrangement: annual judgments from the ascendant of the turning of the year, conjunctions and oppositions of the superior planets, monthly universal applications, and historical dates of prophets, imams, saints, scholars, and sultans. It also lists additional astrological material, including planetary periods, solstices, rainbows, earthquakes, omens, Persian day elections, lunar mansions, planetary aspects, and the Moon’s signs.
